visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video begins with a mouth-watering extreme close-up of several cooked shrimp seasoned with garlic and chili flakes, glistening under warm studio lights. The camera slowly pans over the texture of the shrimp shell. (2) A male chef in a white t-shirt and denim apron appears in a medium shot, holding a plate of large raw tiger shrimp. He uses scissors to meticulously butterfly the backs of the shrimp. (3) In a top-down view, ingredients like golden sesame oil, a cracked egg, and pepper salt are poured into a glass bowl containing the shrimp. Hands wearing plastic gloves mix the contents vigorously to ensure even coating. (4) Dark soy sauce is drizzled from a bottle onto the shrimp, followed by a sprinkle of white cornstarch. The mixture is tossed again with chopsticks. (5) The shrimp are arranged in the metal basket of a bright red air fryer. A hand turns the silver dial to 200 degrees for 6 minutes. (6) The air fryer opens to reveal partially cooked shrimp. Minced garlic, red chili pieces, and green spring onions are tossed on top. (7) The tray is slid back in, and the timer is set for a final 3 minutes. (8) The final scene shows the perfectly cooked, crispy shrimp being lifted with chopsticks, highlighting the vibrant orange color and the aromatic seasoning crust.
